# Desk Pretending To Be A Computer

Alan Kay's Dynabook was a tablet decades early, yet the desktop metaphor made machines look like offices. Someone copied a desk so people would not panic, then kept stretching it until the trash can sat beside a filing cabinet nobody has ever owned. I like that the pretend desk got weirder over time. My own rooms are a bit like that: I built a desk for a machine that has no hands, and I still keep the lamp on.
